description: The whole ledger is a function of the git-log file plus SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, so two builds of one history agree byte for byte. First-parent chain oldest first: a root commit (kind commit), a merge carrying the Channel-Auto trailer of the auto lane (kind merge, mode auto — derived from the trailer, never from forge metadata), a v-tagged commit (kind release), then exactly one trailing build entry whose ts is SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, ref the content tree hash and actor the process actor. Genesis prev is 64 zeros; actor comes from Signed-off-by normalized to human:<id>. No proposal, review or refresh entry exists at 1.0. A fictitious contributor, `Ada Example <ada@example.org>`, signs every Signed-off-by trailer, so every commit entry's actor is `human:ada`; each `hash` is recomputed independently of the engine under AGSC-08-22 — SHA-256 over the 64-character lowercase-hex `prev` followed by the JCS bytes of the entry without its `hash`.
reason: 2026-10-29: the case pins a trailing build entry whose actor names the builder, process:agsc/0.1.0; from 1.1 the actor is the fixed string process:agsc (AGSC-08-20a). Republished as ledger-0011.
